description: This file defines an Angular service class 'EntityViewsTableConfigResolver' that configures and resolves table settings for entity views, including actions, columns, and data fetching logic, within the Thingsboard UI project.

classes.name: EntityViewsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular service class that configures and resolves entity view table settings, including data loading, actions, and UI components, based on route parameters and user authority.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with dependencies and sets default table settings.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and returns the table configuration based on route parameters and user authority.

methods.name: configureColumns
methods.description: Defines table columns based on the entity view scope.

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Sets data fetching and deletion functions depending on scope.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Defines row-level actions like make public, assign, unassign based on scope.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Defines bulk actions for selected entities based on scope.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Defines header actions for adding new entity views.

methods.name: addEntityViewsToCustomer
methods.description: Opens dialog to add entity views to a customer.

methods.name: openEntityView
methods.description: Navigates to the entity view detail page.

methods.name: makePublic
methods.description: Marks an entity view as public.

methods.name: assignToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns selected entity views to a customer.

methods.name: unassignFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes assignment of an entity view from a customer.

methods.name: unassignEntityViewsFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes multiple entity views from a customer.

methods.name: onEntityViewAction
methods.description: Handles specific actions triggered on entity views.

methods.name: addEntityViewsToEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to add entity views to an edge.

methods.name: unassignFromEdge
methods.description: Removes an entity view from an edge.

methods.name: unassignEntityViewsFromEdge
methods.description: Removes multiple entity views from an edge.
